name: Login with valid credentials reaches dashboard with user data
description: A registered user logs in with email and password and lands on the dashboard with their stats and recent work visible.

planSteps.description: Navigate to https://vi-career-ai.vercel.app/login
Enter testsprite@gmail.com in the email field
Enter 12testsprite12 in the password field
Submit the login form
Verify the dashboard page loads showing a welcome message and the quota stat cards (Created CVs, Cover Letters, Job Analysis)

name: Creating a new CV saves and appears in CV history
description: A logged-in user creates a new CV by filling in personal information and a work experience entry, saves it, and the CV appears in their CV history list.

planSteps.description: Navigate to https://vi-career-ai.vercel.app/login
Enter testsprite@gmail.com in the email field
Enter 12testsprite12 in the password field
Submit the login form
Click the New CV button on the dashboard
Select a CV template to start the editor
Fill in the full name field with a test name in the personal information section
Fill in the email field with a test email in the personal information section
Navigate to the work experience section
Add a new work experience entry with a position and company name
Save the CV
Navigate to the CV history page
Verify the newly created CV appears as a card in the CV history list with the entered name visible

name: Generating a cover letter with AI produces letter content
description: A logged-in user navigates to cover letter creation, fills in job details, generates a letter with AI, and the generated letter text appears in the editor.

planSteps.description: Navigate to https://vi-career-ai.vercel.app/login
Enter testsprite@gmail.com in the email field
Enter 12testsprite12 in the password field
Submit the login form
Click the Write Letter button on the dashboard
Fill in the company name field
Fill in the position/job title field
Trigger the AI letter generation
Verify generated cover letter text appears in the letter content area and is not empty or a JSON object

name: Discovering a job and adding it to application tracker
description: A logged-in user searches for jobs in Discover Jobs, opens a listing, and adds it to their application tracker board where it appears in the Saved column.

planSteps.description: Navigate to https://vi-career-ai.vercel.app/login
Enter testsprite@gmail.com in the email field
Enter 12testsprite12 in the password field
Submit the login form
Click the Discover Jobs link in the sidebar
Search for software developer jobs
Open the first job listing from the search results
Click the manual add button on the application tracker board
Fill in the company and position fields in the add application dialog
Submit the add application form
Verify a new card with the entered company name appears in the Saved column of the application tracker board
